note: DANGER BOUNTY の説明(カード詳細・3択)
ja: 雑魚の一部が高火力敵(赤紫のオーラ。攻撃のダメージ+1ハート)になる(1Lvごとに+3%、最大30%。0kmから)。代わりに敵撃破・BONUSのMILE+15%/Lv、敵撃破EXP+10%/Lv。敵が変わるのはソロの通常マップだけ
en: Some enemies become Heavy Hitters (magenta aura, +1 heart damage) (+3% per Lv, up to 30%, from 0km). In return: enemy/BONUS MILE +15% per Lv, enemy defeat EXP +10% per Lv. Enemies only change in solo runs on normal maps

note: SKY SIEGE の説明(カード詳細・3択)
ja: 空中の敵の枠に空中雑魚(急降下・横切りなど)が出やすくなり(+5%/Lv)、空の敵がいる組も出やすくなる(+10%/Lv)。代わりに敵撃破EXP+15%/Lv、敵撃破・BONUSのMILE+8%/Lv
en: Air enemies (divers, crossers, etc.) fill air slots more often (+5% per Lv), and groups with flying enemies appear more often (+10% per Lv). In return: enemy defeat EXP +15% per Lv, enemy/BONUS MILE +8% per Lv

note: CROSSROADS の説明(カード詳細・3択)
ja: 道中の判断イベント(上下の帯・封鎖・高火力敵など)が早い距離から始まり(通常50km → 1Lvごとに4km早く、最短10km)、間隔も短くなる(-5%/Lv、最大-50%)。代わりに敵撃破・BONUSのMILE+12%/Lv、獲得EXP+8%/Lv。判断イベントはソロの通常マップだけ
en: Road decision events (lane warnings, blockades, Heavy Hitters, etc.) start earlier (normally 50km; 4km earlier per Lv, 10km at the earliest) and come more often (gap -5% per Lv, up to -50%). In return: enemy/BONUS MILE +12% per Lv, EXP gained +8% per Lv. Decision events only happen in solo runs on normal maps

note: HIGH STAKES の説明(カード詳細・3択)
ja: ボスから受けるダメージ+10%/Lv(ハート単位。端数は確率で1つ増える)。代わりにボス撃破MILE+35%/Lv、ボス撃破EXP+15%/Lv
en: Damage taken from bosses +10% per Lv (in hearts; a fraction may add 1 more heart). In return: boss defeat MILE +35% per Lv, boss defeat EXP +15% per Lv

note: CHAIN BOUNTY の説明(カード詳細・3択)
ja: 連続ヒットが10HIT以上続いている間に倒した雑魚のMILEと撃破EXPが増える(+15%/Lv)。連続ヒットを切らさずに倒し続けるほど得
en: Enemies defeated while your hit streak is at 10 HIT or more give more MILE and defeat EXP (+15% per Lv). Keep the streak going while you defeat enemies

note: IRON MARATHON の説明(カード詳細・3択)
ja: 被弾せずに1km走るたびにMILE+3とEXP+150(1Lvごとに増加)。被弾すると数え直し(Shieldで防いだ時はそのまま)
en: Every 1km you run without taking damage gives +3 MILE and EXP +150 (more per Lv). Taking damage resets the count (blocking with a Shield doesn't)

note: TROPHY HUNT の説明(カード詳細・3択)
ja: ボスを倒すと、前のボスから倒した雑魚1体につきMILE+0.2とEXP+3(1Lvごとに増加、最大100体分)。雑魚を倒してからボスへ挑むほど得
en: Defeating a boss gives +0.2 MILE and EXP +3 for each enemy defeated since the previous boss (more per Lv, up to 100 enemies). Clear out enemies before you take on the boss

note: HORIZON の説明(カード詳細・3択)
ja: 走行距離10kmごとに、敵撃破・ボス・BONUSのMILEと獲得EXPが+2%/Lvずつ増える(100kmで最大、Lv1で+20%)。遠くまで走るほど伸びる
en: Every 10km you run, enemy/boss/BONUS MILE and EXP gained rise by +2% per Lv (max at 100km; +20% at Lv1). The farther you run, the more it grows
